meta.headline: **Why hire** our **developers** to grow a mobile-first ordering team?
meta.summary: Sweet Scoop needed pick-up ordering before summer. Two React Native engineers, a UX designer and a QA analyst joined their team and shipped a two-tap reorder flow in 14 weeks.

blocks.title: A **two-tap reorder** flow, shipped before peak season.

blocks.body: Sweet Scoop's stores were losing summer sales to long lines. We joined their in-house developer with a small, embedded squad to design and ship a pick-up ordering app for iOS and Android, connected to the chain's existing point-of-sale system.

image.alt: Ice-cream cone against a pastel wall

blocks.title: Challenge
blocks.body: A single in-house developer, a POS vendor with a limited API and a hard deadline: the app had to be in the stores before the first heat wave.

blocks.title: Solution
body: We embedded two React Native engineers, a UX designer and a QA analyst working in the client's time zone and tools.
The team built a thin integration layer over the POS, a saved-favourites reorder flow and automated release checks so the in-house developer could own the app after hand-off.
